purpose: Find evidence-backed shape asset authoring after the frozen direct field failed; no external fitted data or code executed.

sources.title: Pinned original PIG_model README
sources.finding: The original pig asset has no shape-blend or pose-blend basis; raw J_regressor can update joints after vertex editing.
sources.decision: Do not invent a released pig shape basis; preserve original source surface and explicitly author qualified variants.

sources.title: As-Rigid-As-Possible Surface Modeling
sources.finding: Local rotation and vertex position optimization provides detail-preserving constrained mesh editing; cotangent edge weighting addresses discretization bias.
sources.decision: Prioritize a bounded constrained authoring capability test, not a natural-shape or biomechanics claim.

sources.title: An accessible and intuitive approach to 3D data modeling for morphometric surface evaluation in pig farming
sources.finding: Statistical pig surface study removes head and tail; reported data cannot be shared.
sources.decision: Not verified as an available full-body rig or compatible shape basis.

sources.title: Pig3DNet: Multi-view 3D reconstruction with pig specific parametric body model for pig body measurements
sources.finding: Describes a pig-specific statistical model; no runnable released asset/code and source-face compatibility verified in this review.
sources.decision: Do not treat paper description or same-name behavior model as a ready dependency; no training or fitted outputs used.
